definitions.explanation: A journey made by ship or boat, whether for leisure (a cruise), transportation (a ferry crossing), or adventure.

examples.japanese: {船旅|ふなたび}を{楽|たの}しむ。
{瀬戸内海|せとないかい}を{船旅|ふなたび}で{巡|めぐ}った。
examples.english: I toured the Seto Inland Sea by boat.

examples.japanese: {飛行機|ひこうき}より{時間|じかん}はかかるが、{船旅|ふなたび}にはのんびりした{魅力|みりょく}がある。
examples.english: It takes longer than flying, but boat travel has a relaxing charm.

notes:
Composed of {船|ふな} (boat, ship) + {旅|たび} (travel, journey). The reading {船|ふな} uses the native Japanese (kun'yomi) reading, as is common in compound nouns with {旅|たび}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {船旅|ふなたび}を{楽|たの}しむ: to enjoy a boat trip
- {船旅|ふなたび}に{出|で}る: to set out on a voyage
- {世界|せかい}{一周|いっしゅう}の{船旅|ふなたび}: around-the-world cruise
- {豪華|ごうか}な{船旅|ふなたび}: luxury cruise

SIMILAR WORDS:
- クルーズ: cruise (loanword; typically implies luxury)
- {航海|こうかい}: voyage, navigation (more formal/technical; emphasizes the sailing itself)
- {渡航|とこう}: overseas travel (by any means, not just ship)
